gizmo.title: Wahi hoʻokuʻu kiʻi
gizmo.description: Kau nā haumāna i nā lepili ma nā wahi i uhi ʻia ma luna o kekahi kiʻi, a laila nānā i kā lākou pane.

configure.title: Kiʻi
configure.description: Ke kiʻi e kau ai nā haumāna i nā lepili.

configure.title: Kikokikona pani
configure.description: Wehewehe i ke kiʻi no ka poʻe hiki ʻole ke ʻike iā ia. Mai hōʻike i kahi e hele ai nā lepili.

configure.title: Poʻo inoa kiʻi
configure.description: He poʻo inoa pōkole ʻike ʻia no ke kiʻi, hōʻike ʻia ma luna ona.

configure.title: Nīnau
configure.description: Ka mea i noi ʻia i nā haumāna e hana me nā lepili.

configure.title: Nā lepili a me nā wahi
configure.description: He lepili kēlā me kēia mea hiki i nā haumāna ke kau. E hāʻawi i ka lepili i inoa wahi e kau ai i kona wahi ma ke kiʻi; ʻo ka lepili me ka inoa wahi ʻole he keu ia ʻaʻohe ona wahi. He pakeneka o ke kiʻi nā helu wahi.

configure.title: Kākau kiʻi
configure.description: Kākau kiʻi koho i hōʻike ʻia ma lalo o ke kiʻi.

advanced.title: Nā hoʻāʻo
advanced.description: ʻEhia manawa e hiki ai i kekahi haumāna ke nānā. ʻO ka 0, palena ʻole.

advanced.title: Hoʻohuikau i nā lepili
advanced.description: Hōʻike i nā lepili ma ke kaʻina ʻokoʻa i kēlā me kēia kipa ʻana.

advanced.title: Hiki ke ʻōpiʻi
advanced.description: Hōʻike i kēia nīnau ma ke ʻano he lālani e wehe a pani ai. Ke wehe ʻia kekahi, pani ʻia nā nīnau ʻōpiʻi ʻē aʻe ma kona ʻaoʻao.

advanced.title: Hoʻomaka me ka ʻōpiʻi
advanced.description: Ke hiki ke ʻōpiʻi, e hoʻomaka ma ke ʻano he lālani pani e hōʻike ana i ka nīnau a me kona kūlana wale nō.

advanced.title: ʻAno kaha helu
advanced.description: OER Schema: ke ʻano kaha helu no kēia loiloi (e laʻa nā ʻai, hua palapala, pakeneka, pau ʻana).

advanced.title: Pahuhopu aʻo
advanced.description: OER Schema: ka pahuhopu aʻo e pili ana i kēia loiloi.

developer.title: Inoa o ka hoʻokolohua
developer.description: Inoa hoʻokolohua i hoʻohana ʻia no ka hōʻike xAPI ma nā ʻōnaehana kālailai.

developer.title: Papa
developer.description: OER Schema: ka papa i manaʻo ʻia ai kēia loiloi.
